findings.issue: Decision ID D-RCV-60 added to the ten new AC9 to AC18 scenario headings; decision IDs must not appear in the story text.
Section 8 gives the REC-09 tolerance as 0.00 under DL25, a number no source supplies; the open decision should read Not specified.
BR15 gives schedule, alert groups, feature flag and DP-17 for the case-side run, which GAP-2238 says have no source, and that run belongs to rwb-case.
Row 12.2 uses a path with a '{}' placeholder that no source publishes; the item is marked Resolved but the story does not resolve it.
The CON dependency RWB-P6-E1011-CON is flagged by lint as not a story of the set; Resolved overstates it, the owner must create it.
Section 10 defines empty, loading, error and no-access states for SCR-44/45 that section 15 marks Not specified (CG-ALL-6335/6336); the two sections contradict.
